reason_no_common_protocol: "{runtime}" speaks {needs}, but channel "{channel}" only offers {offers}, so they can't connect.
reason_runtime_not_ready: "{runtime}" is not set up on {machine} yet.
reason_channel_not_ready: {machine} has no such sign-in or launcher for "{runtime}".
reason_no_launcher: No launcher runs "{runtime}" on channel "{channel}" yet. Add a binding for it in the channel first.
reason_bridged_experimental: Channel "{channel}" reaches this through a compatibility bridge (experimental). It may have known issues and is not a default recommendation.
reason_effort_clamped: {model} does not take thinking level {effort}; it will run at {clamped}.
reason_effort_ignored: "{runtime}" takes no thinking level, so {effort} has no effect.
reason_model_unlisted: Channel "{channel}" lists no models, so whether {model} works is only known when it runs.
reason_machine_offline: {machine} is offline; it runs once the computer is back.
reason_readiness_unknown: What is installed on {machine} is not known yet; it is confirmed after its next sync.
err_alias_read_only: "{launcher}" is an alias of channel "{channel}". Change or remove it in the channel.
err_channel_revision: The channels were just changed elsewhere. Refresh and try again.
err_no_rollback: There is no channel version to roll back to.
err_channel_field: The {field} of channel "{channel}" is not valid. Check it and save again.
err_channel_name: Channel name "{name}" can't be used: use letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or underscore.
err_channel_name_taken: "{name}" is already a launcher's name. Choose another channel name, or fold that launcher into the channel.
err_channel_quota: The usage source of channel "{channel}" is not valid: give a source and the claude or codex provider.
err_alias_taken: Launcher name "{launcher}" is already used by "{channel}". Choose another alias.
err_replace: "{launcher}" can't be folded into channel "{channel}": it must be a launcher of its own with a binding of the same name in the channel.
err_runtime_unmanaged: "{runtime}" can't run as a managed launcher, so it can't be bound to a channel.
err_no_last_good: This conversation has no record of a run that went well yet.
